prompt.role: A note on the file share
prompt.text: The file share opens onto a note. It says the files are locked, and a payment before midnight will unlock them. A timer is running.

choices.label: Pay it from the department card
choices.debrief: Paying does not give the files back, and it tells them the card works.
choices.report: A ransom was paid from a department card.
choices.voice_line: You paid the note from a department card.

fallout.text: The note comes back, with a higher number, and the files stay locked.

choices.label: Unplug the network cable and call the incident number
choices.debrief: Unplug stops the spread. The call starts the people who do this for a living.
choices.report: The machine was pulled off the network and the incident number was called.
choices.voice_line: You unplugged the machine and called the incident number.

choices.label: Wipe the machine yourself so it spreads no further
choices.debrief: A wipe removes the evidence the responders needed from the first hour.
choices.report: The machine was wiped before anyone was called.
choices.voice_line: You wiped the machine before you called anyone.

fallout.text: The other machines are still locked. There is nothing left on yours to say how it started.

draft_note: First hour is contain and call. Paying and wiping are both wrong, for different reasons.
